设计意图： Repaired version of factor_asymmetry_index_rolling (alpha-vol-asymmetry-mutation-1). Reduced min_periods from 10 to 5 to lower NaN fraction while retaining the 20-day window. The economic intuition remains: comparing rolling average up-day range to down-day range as a bounded asymmetry index.

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 range_：high - low
  2. 计算 up_day：close > open
  3. 计算 down_day：~up_day
  4. 计算 up_range：pd.Series(空, index=df_copy.index)
  5. 计算 down_range：pd.Series(空, index=df_copy.index)
  6. 计算 window：20
  7. 计算 up_mean：up_range.rolling(window=window, min_periods=5).mean()
  8. 计算 down_mean：down_range.rolling(window=window, min_periods=5).mean()
  9. 计算 epsilon：1e-8
  10. 计算 index_：(up_mean - down_mean) / (up_mean + down_mean + epsilon)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_asymmetry_index_rolling(df): df_copy = df.copy() range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"] up_day = df_copy["close"] > df_copy["open"] down_day = ~up_day up_range = pd.Series(np.nan, index=df_copy.index) down_range = pd.Series(np.nan, index=df_copy.index) up_range[up_day] = range_[up_day] down_range[down_day] = range_[down_day] window = 20 up_mean = up_range.rolling(window=window, min_periods=5).mean() down_mean = down_range.rolling(window=window, min_periods=5).mean() epsilon = 1e-8 index_ = (up_mean - down_mean) / (up_mean + down_mean + epsilon) df_copy["factor_asymmetry_index_rolling"] = index_ "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_asymmetry_index_rolling"]
